title: Split over-budget and near-budget procedures into base and child files
goal: Every procedure file stays under the per-file budget with room for its next edit, every requirement kept
acceptance: check:rule-load reports no procedure over budget and none above 1,900 tokens among the split files
Moved text is verbatim and traced; each base links its child with the trigger to read it
New children are registered in both .harness.json files, BACKLOG-RULES and the procedure index
privacy: Procedure and config text only; no personal data.
escalation: A requirement that cannot move verbatim is kept in the base, never dropped

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 at agent speed; implemented 2026-11-24, review, CI and release remain. Closed 2026-11-24.
